Diego Ramos: Heads up Hummingbyte INV-2026-0581 ($62,400) moved into dunning today — payment attempt flagged as returned.
Priya Kapoor: I pinged Eli earlier, waiting on AP confirmation. Eli, any update on payment timing?
Eli (Hummingbyte): sorry team, we're mid-quarter transition and short on cash until new funding clears. we can do a split: $30k wire today, $16,200 on 2026-05-01, and $16,200 on 2026-05-15. we'll provide a signed payment schedule.
Diego Ramos: That helps. We need txn id and remittance when the wire goes out. Also want signed PO or email approval on the schedule.
Eli (Hummingbyte): will send signed doc from CFO in 2 hours. wire will be from Hummingbyte LLC.
jess-billing-bot: Automated: invoice INV-2026-0581 status updated to "partial payment plan" pending receipt of first wire. Dunning emails suspended until 2026-05-16.
Priya Kapoor: Terms we can offer: accept the split, waive one late fee if both follow-ups hit on schedule, but require a payment plan doc and CC on file retained as fallback. legal ok with non-standard schedule?
LegalOps Bot: Flag: need approval for any payment plan >30 days. Please attach signed plan to matter ID: LEG-2026-184.
Diego Ramos: @LegalOps Bot noted. Eli please attach the signed doc here and email billing@redwood.com with remittance and wire reference. Once we get $30k we'll mark partially paid and remove account from collections queue.
Eli (Hummingbyte): wire sent, tx id: WB-202605-77a, remittance uploaded to billing@redwood.com. attached signed schedule in reply.
Priya Kapoor: Received remittance and schedule. Posted to invoice, recorded $30,000. Remaining balance $32,400 scheduled as above. I set Salesforce flag RW-4011 to "payment plan" and added follow-up reminders.
Diego Ramos: Good. We'll hold collections, waive the late fee once the 2nd payment clears. If either follow-up fails, we revert to standard dunning and escalate. Sam (collections) — you OK with that?
Priya Kapoor: Sam is out today but I ran it by collections lead — agreed.
Eli (Hummingbyte): really appreciate the flexibility. CFO asked to confirm we won't be charged interest if schedule met?
Diego Ramos: Confirmed: no additional interest or fees if payments happen as scheduled and signed plan is honored.
jess-billing-bot: Note saved: Payment plan accepted for INV-2026-0581. Audit trail: remittance WB-202605-77a, plan attached LEG-2026-184. Next automated follow-up set for 2026-05-02.
Priya Kapoor: Closing loop here — will monitor ACH hits and ping legal if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Diego Ramos: Thanks everyone. Audit note: attach PO-9922 and the signed schedule to the invoice record.
